static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.social_status: Limited social interaction after moving to a new city, mainly Being alone and playing video games
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems before; no psychotherapy history; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic, high cooperativeness, calm tone, able to describe feelings and experiences concretely

basic_info.main_problem: I repeatedly have the thought that 'because I am Living alone and spend most of my free time playing video games, I am a terrible person'; this belief causes Self-doubt and low sense of self-worth.
basic_info.core_demands: When these negative thoughts began to affect my emotions and daily activities and reduce my enjoyment of cooking and playing guitar, I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Moved to a new city and started Living alone a few months ago, initially producing Moderate stress from adapting to the new environment and feelings of Loneliness; this gradually developed into negative thoughts appearing almost daily after Being alone or playing video games (such as 'I am wasting my life' 'I should go out and meet people'), gradually affecting interest in cooking and guitar playing and performance in the kitchen.

special_situations.event: Living alone after moving to a new city, mostly playing video games alone on weekends and in free time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not spend time on more 'productive' or more social things, it means I am a not-good-enough/terrible person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Uses cooking, playing guitar, or continuing to play games to distract attention; avoids telling friends about these negative thoughts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am wasting my life; I should go out and meet people

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I enjoy and spend a lot of time playing games, it means I lack self-discipline and have no achievements
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to stop gaming or switch to other activities (cooking, guitar), but lacks a systematic plan
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: You are wasting your life; you are just someone who plays games

special_situations.event: When social interaction is limited in a new city and staying home alone
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not immediately built a social circle and am often alone, it means something is wrong with me and I am not worthy of being liked
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding sharing vulnerability and negative thoughts with friends, staying alone to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am a terrible person because I live alone and have no social life

special_situations.event: When interest in cooking and guitar playing declines and kitchen performance suffers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not enjoy cooking now or perform poorly, it proves I am not good enough/a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding frustration by continuing to play games or cooking less
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not a good Chef; I am not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted, to have worth and belonging
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as 'not good enough' or Being rejected
defense_goal: Controlling and avoiding being negated through self-reproach and following internalized 'should' rules
Maintains some distance to reduce the risk of being judged

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough Loneliness person, an individual tending toward Self-deprecation
object_relations.object_representation: Others are experienced as potential judges and enforcers of standards

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others invite affirming one's enjoyment and value of games or Being alone
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing that admitting enjoyment means one is irresponsible and will be judged as 'not good enough'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a gentle, supportive tone, helping them identify the source of 'should', distinguishing outside standards from one's own needs; encouraging testing beliefs with specific evidence and allowing present feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When proposed to share negative thoughts with friends or expand social connections
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously believing expressing vulnerability leads to Being rejected or looked down on
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Steady tone, gradually guides them to label present experiences with concrete feeling words, keeping short sentences and pauses, reducing pressure and defensive intensity.

manifestations: Living alone after moving to a new city
Limited social interaction, often feeling Loneliness
Spending most free time playing video games alone
outcomes: Self-doubt and low sense of self-worth
Reduced interest in cooking and guitar
Declining daily functioning and kitchen performance

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths
manifestations: Repeatedly using statements like 'I should be more productive' 'I should go out and meet people'
Directly equating playing games with 'not worthy/not good enough'

contact_model.definition: Restrains the impulse to seek others' support outwardly, instead turning it on oneself (such as self-blame, self-exhaustion)
manifestations: Not yet sharing negative thoughts and troubles with friends
Tries to 'solve' problems through self-blame or distraction rather than seeking help directly

contact_model.definition: Excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, overly cautious about contact
manifestations: Frequent self-criticism ('I am not good enough' 'I am wasting my life')
Cautiously tests when trying new activities, worrying about being evaluated

positive_force: Open attitude toward trying new methods (willing to do behavioral experiments and record observations)
Having hobby skills like cooking and guitar, which can serve as resources for connection and pleasure
Has a few friends to talk to, with potential social support
Able to clearly express and identify negative Automatic thoughts
negative_force: Tending to evaluate oneself with 'should' rules (Introjected conditions of worth)
Excessive self-criticism, using cognitive patterns such as emotional reasoning and overgeneralization
Living alone in a new city leading to a limited social circle, strong feelings of Loneliness
Linking leisure behavior with personal value, prone to guilt and shame
Avoids sharing vulnerability with others; maintains isolation and the negative cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated negative self-talk of Self-deprecation and guilt (such as 'I am wasting my life' 'I am not good enough')
antecedent: Living alone after moving to a new city
When realizing one's social interaction is limited
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalized 'should' standards and outside conditions of worth, combined with emotional reasoning from Loneliness experiences, directly equating leisure with 'terrible person/not good enough'
target_behavior.function: Trying to force oneself to be more 'productive' or more social through self-punishment and Self-monitoring, and escaping the Fear of facing judgment
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood, Decreased sense of self-worth, Reduced interest in cooking and guitar, kitchen Performance affected, further Reduced socializing

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding sharing negative thoughts with friends or others, reduced social contact
antecedent: When considering going out socially or expressing vulnerability
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing Being rejected or judged as 'not good enough', using Emotional isolation and Retroflection to lower Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Escapes possible negative evaluation and intimacy risks, maintaining subjective safety and a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent Loneliness and problem cycle, lacking outside support, worsening Negative emotions, further declining interests and functioning
